National security concerns and data usage questions are the primary reasons for this decision. The Indian government cited political grounds for halting the integration of the payment platforms. Law enforcement agencies also raised concerns about money laundering and data breaches.

banking-economy.title: Need money urgently? Here's how to choose the right funding option.
banking-economy.summary: Facing a financial emergency necessitates a strategic approach to funding resources. For SBI Credit Card users, features like Flexipay and Balance Transfer on EMI can alleviate immediate pressures. Although Cash Advance is available for urgent cash needs, it presents hefty charges; hence, it should be reserved for critical situations. Analyzing one's ability to repay, alongside differentiating between direct cash needs and payments to merchants, is key.
